description: How the app finds the local Codex CLI when it was launched from Finder and inherited no shell PATH. Discovery only looks at absolute locations in a fixed order and then at the inherited PATH variable itself: it never starts an interactive shell, so a shell profile, an alias or the working directory can never decide which binary runs. The absolute path from settings is tried first, a missing CLI is a missing_config error and a binary that exists but fails to run is a process error; both only concern Codex, so GLM and DeepSeek keep collecting.
